_status: 8 images placed from five sessions, interleaved so no single shoot reads as a block. Two frames (soccer, track) are still the watermarked versions pending originals.
_selectionGuidance: Aim for a spread that speaks to both audiences: a few personality-driven, model-like frames the senior would choose, and a few timeless portraits a parent would want for announcements and graduation displays. Show at least one senior with something meaningful to them — an instrument, uniform, sport, vehicle, animal — since that is the whole argument for a personalized senior session.
_actionRequired: seniors-03-soccer-bleachers.jpg and seniors-04-track-lanes.jpg are currently the WATERMARKED versions. Replace with clean originals under the same filenames. All six new files are also below the 2000px export standard — replace with full-resolution originals when located.
_concentrationNote: Six of the eight are family members — one granddaughter, one niece. Acceptable as a bridge, but this is exactly what the January 2027 review exists to correct. Prioritise replacing these with paying-client work covered by signed releases.
